comment: Cross-language golden cases for the roster.csv extra-column header rules. Both readers accept any columns after the canonical seven and round-trip them (Go: parseRoster/EncodeRoster in cli/gh-teacher/internal/configrepo/students_csv.go; TS: parseRosterCsv/stringifyStudentsCsv in web/src/util/rosterCsv.ts), and both must refuse the same malformed headers so neither tool writes a file the other rejects. `extra_columns` are appended to the canonical header; `accept` is whether a file with that header and one valid data row parses without a header problem. Scoping: the web trims header names before applying these rules (Papa transformHeader) and the CLI reads them verbatim, so a name that differs only by surrounding whitespace, or a tab/CR-led name, is a known divergence and is deliberately not a case here. Update both readers in lockstep.

cases.why: an empty header name is accepted
a duplicated extra column would clobber on read
an extra column reusing a canonical name
